title: Export response (CONTRACT.md 5.1, operations profile)
description: What the reserved export tool returns as structuredContent, and `<tool> export --json` prints: the artifact and the file its portable form was written to, in the tool's own data directory. Never a run.

path.description: The absolute path the tool chose, outside any run directory.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's bytes, lowercase hex.

media_type.description: The bundle's media type for a `bundle` type; application/json for a `json` type.
